annotations.title: Compare broker margin rates at a balance

description: Every compared broker's published annual margin rate on one loan balance, ranked from lowest to highest (ties shared), with the tier that applies, the yearly interest at that rate, schedule dates and source links. Brokers that print no rate at that balance are listed separately with the reason.

balance.description: Margin loan (debit balance) in US dollars, e.g. 100000.
